This innovative tool allows advisors to seamlessly transition from client discussions to fully completing, verifying, and receiving signed account opening processes in the duration of a standard advisor-client meeting. Previously, the account opening process necessitated advisors and operations teams to navigate through various client forms and CRM systems.

data.title: SilverRide appoints Salesforce Cofounder Dave Moellenhoff to its Board of Directors as Company Scales Its Technology Platform
data.description: In San Francisco, SilverRide Inc. revealed the addition of Dave Moellenhoff, former Chief Technology Officer of Salesforce, to their Board of Directors. As the nation's primary assisted transportation platform for older adults and individuals with disabilities, this move is significant. Moellenhoff, a co-founder of Salesforce in 1999, held the positions of Chief Technology Officer and principal architect until 2009. His appointment is effective immediately and marks a strategic development for SilverRide.

data.title: AMAZON TEAMSTERS RALLY FOR DELIVERY PROTECTION ACT
data.description: Teamsters in Chicago are calling on the City Council to pass a Logistics Reform Ordinance. Tomorrow, hundreds of Amazon Teamsters in Chicago will gather for a rally with local elected officials and labor and civil society coalition allies to push for the passage of this ordinance. This event is set to take place on Tuesday, September 15, 2026. The rally will highlight the demands and concerns of workers in the logistics sector, emphasizing the need for reform. This demonstration underscores the support from various groups, indicating a significant level of advocacy surrounding this issue within the Chicago community.

data.title: Sempra Infrastructure Announces Long-Term LNG Supply Agreement with Petrobras
data.description: Today, in Houston, Sempra Infrastructure, a subsidiary of Sempra (NYSE: SRE), disclosed a significant 20-year sales and purchase agreement (SPA) with Petrobras. According to this agreement, Sempra Infrastructure will be providing around 0.8 million tonnes per annum (Mtpa) of liquefied natural gas to Petrobras.

data.title: Miller Children's & Women's Hospital Performs First Minima Stent Procedure for Infants with Congenital Heart Conditions
data.description: The Children's Heart Institute at Miller Children's & Women's Hospital in Long Beach, California, has recently accomplished the successful implementation of the Renata stent - the first FDA-approved stent tailored for the tiniest patients with specific congenital heart and vascular conditions. This significant development took place on September 14, 2026.

data.title: FirstService Residential communities raise more than $56,000 in honor of the 25th anniversary of September 11
data.description: On September 14, 2026, two Texas communities under the management of FirstService Residential commemorated the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks. The event brought together residents, first responders, and local partners in Dallas in remembrance and support for charitable causes.

data.title: Pine Ridge Vineyards Celebrates 30 Years of Its Iconic Chenin Blanc + Viognier and Announces Expanded Role for Winemaker Josh Widaman
data.description: Pine Ridge Vineyards has been nominated for the prestigious Wine Enthusiast 2026 Wine Star Awards in the category of American Winery of the Year. Alongside this recognition, their renowned Chenin Blanc + Viognier blend is undergoing a transformation under the guidance of Josh Widaman. This move comes as Widaman aims to maintain the winery's reputation for exceptional Cabernet Sauvignon. Hailing from Napa Valley, this development indicates an exciting new chapter for the vineyard.

data.title: KanEquip JCB Rolls into Kansas City
data.description: A new branch of KanEquip JCB is set to open in Kansas City, Kansas on September 14, 2026. The facility will focus on sales, parts, and service for JCB equipment, enhancing support for JCB customers in the area. This expansion will bolster the company's presence in the region and provide specialized services to clients.

data.title: Zip Security Joins CrowdStrike's Project QuiltWorks to Secure SMBs Against Frontier AI Risk
data.description: Zip Security has introduced its managed security platform to Project QuiltWorks, a coalition spearheaded by CrowdStrike, providing advanced AI risk protection to businesses with limited or no security teams. This move was made public on September 14, 2026, in New York. Zip Security aims to enhance cybersecurity measures for companies, especially those lacking robust security resources. By joining forces with Project QuiltWorks, they will extend their services to more businesses in need of cybersecurity solutions.

data.title: California Waste Solutions Plans New Renewable Energy Facility To Help Vietnam Achieve National Net Zero Target
data.description: Vietnam Waste Solutions (VWS), operated by a California-based company, is undertaking a major project in Ho Chi Minh City. The plan involves expanding and converting the current landfill to include a 50-60 megawatt waste-to-energy plant and new recycling facilities. This will enhance VWS's current operations and contribute to sustainable waste management in the city.
